title: Grateful Dead Live at Fox Theater on 1985-10-28
lineage: Master PCM > DAW (via SEKD Prodif) > Wav; Mastering by Droncit; Editing with Diamond Cut Forensics 8 and Forensics 9 (alpha). BCE de-emphasis curve (modified PCM de-emphasis) applied. May 19,2014
source: Source: Schoeps CMC441s (90deg, 17cm) > Oade M118 > Oade mod SONY PCM-F1;

ai_review.summary: A high‑quality audience recording captures a mellow yet well‑played set with standout Touch of Grey and an outstanding Ramble On Rose featuring Brent’s superb keyboard solo.
ai_review.review: The Oade/Schoeps ambient capture delivers crystal‑clear bass, balanced crowd ambience and a vivid live feel that fans rave about. Musically the show is solid—though not as epic as other ’85 dates, it shines on Touch of Grey and a killer Ramble On Rose with Brent Mydland’s soaring solo. Overall listeners find the performance enjoyable and the recording excellent.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviewers gave 4‑5 stars, praising both the musical performance and the superb ambient recording; no significant negatives were noted.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audience capture with Schoeps mics praised for deep bass response, clear instrument definition and a perfect balance between crowd and music; listeners describe it as beautiful live sound.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set is described as mellow yet appreciative, well‑played throughout; not the most epic night of the ’85 tour but consistently solid with high energy moments (e.g., Touch of Grey) and a highlight in the second half (Ramble On Rose).

band_member_comments.Keys: Excellent Brent Mydland keyboard work, especially his solo on Ramble On Rose.
